name: 05 - Letter Review, Notarization & Dispatch
description: Webhook-triggered letter dispatch: extracts approved letter IDs, optionally routes through Proof.com notarization, renders PDF, mails via Lob certified, marks mailed in DB, notifies client. Webhook: POST /webhook/credit-repair/letters/approve

parameters.query:
SELECT dl.letter_id, dl.case_id, dl.bureau, dl.round, dl.letter_body, dl.requires_notarization,
       c.first_name, c.last_name, c.street, c.city, c.state, c.zip
FROM dispute_letters dl
JOIN cases c ON c.case_id = dl.case_id
WHERE dl.letter_id = ANY(ARRAY[{{ $json.letter_ids_str }}]::int[])
  AND dl.letter_status = 'pending_review';
